# `init` inside a registered single-agent session moves the session into the new project.
> mkdir -p app && echo '{"session_id":"s-2","cwd":"'"$W"'/app","transcript_path":"","source":"startup"}' | CLAUDE_ENV_FILE="$W/env" python3 "$PYLACARTA" hook session-start > /dev/null
@env env
$ ask --title "Left open"
$ --root app init --name "App"
$ --project $LACARTA_PROJECT status
$ --root app status
$ --root app agent list
